content: AirSwap Registry.sol: immutable stakingToken/obligationCost/tokenCost; stakerURLs mapping; setURL/addTokens/addProtocols to register; getURLsForToken(token) for discovery; events InitialStake/FullUnstake/AddTokens/RemoveTokens/SetURL. rfq_registry's function names (set_url/add_tokens/add_protocols/eject/get_urls_for_token/get_maker) are the faithful Soroban port of this shape, confirmed by REG-01 and the spec's own §5 sketch.
